Two recommended ways to improve the comprehensibility and accountability of algorithmic systems for users, according to the CNIL report, are:

1. Establishing an obligation for system operators to provide clear and understandable information about the functioning logic of algorithms, not just upon request from users, to enhance transparency and intelligibility.

2. Organizing a form of "joignabilité" (contactability) of algorithmic systems by identifying a responsible team within each organization that manages the algorithm, ensuring that users can easily contact them for information and accountability.
